coordinate_space: Blender / AP-001 metres, +Z up; NO axis conversion (Unity applies bakeAxisConversion); Unity (X,Z) -> (x,y), Unity Y -> z; rotation_euler_deg about +z CCW from +x; scale baked

regions.label: Palace courtyard (Round-1 start)
regions.identity: Open blue-grey paving plane, nothing taller than 0.45 m inside the square; four planter corners are the only accents - the reference silhouette against which every other region reads

regions.label: Palace front + broad stone way
regions.identity: Longest horizontal: plaster + grey roof band of the palace over a 14 m wide stone way; dark timber posts at 3.4 m rhythm frame the way, planters keep the green as thin strips, two mauve sakura flank the facade

regions.label: Sakura garden
regions.identity: Mauve crowns over stone: 12 sakura pairs, stone lanterns and planter+cap low walls (<= 0.55 m) edge the curved medium paths; the fork diamond holds the hero tree

regions.label: Koi pond + bridge line
regions.identity: Horizontal grey / blue-green: three dark water planes ringed by pale rim stone, the 1.45 m bridge as a thin dark band at x=4, light gravel shore paths on routes 21/22, rocks and low greens - the only wet region

regions.label: Bamboo garden + closed corridor
regions.identity: Vertical green rhythm: culm verticals over a dark-wood / grey-roof corridor band; sparse ground, open-lattice fences on the boundaries, the shortest sightlines on the map

instances.plan_note: plane mesh is at local z -0.15 => world -0.15 with pivot z 0
